evaluator_handoff.baseline_coefficients_status: not saved by training; per-type metrics only. Separate agent must fit/freeze same-C1 head on exact 460 train questions and hash it before fresh60 inference.
freeze_then_evaluate: freeze run config, best checkpoint hashes, prompts/profiles, candidate ordering, evaluator code hashes and all system revisions before opening references

evaluator_handoff.frozen_baseline_protocol: Fit same C=1.0 head-only scorer using only the exact 460-question training subset; persist/hash coefficients before opening fresh60. Do not use the historical 660-question frozen probe as an equivalent same-split baseline.
evaluator_handoff.known_blocker: The same-split head-only baseline JSON stores dev metrics only, not coefficients. A separate evaluator must fit and hash the C=1 baseline coefficients on the frozen 460 train subset before evaluating, never on the sealed 60.
evaluator_handoff.label_access_protocol: No references/targets/rationales in prediction phase. Hash/freeze every system output and evaluator code before opening fresh60 references for scoring.

shared.selection_caveat: This LoRA run fitted 460 of 660 questions and selected epoch by a grouped 200-question dev set. Historical frozen embedding probes used/OOF-scored all 660 questions; their metrics are not directly comparable.
shared.selection_note: The frozen epoch is the min aggregate dev objective-loss epoch. Exact dev accuracy is lower there than the C=1 head-only weighted exact accuracy on this same split; this is a train/dev result only and should be disclosed to the orchestrator before any holdout opening.
